note: The archive-only statements BH-7035 slice C0 added to the readers it ported: the same read without a JOIN or NOT EXISTS on a hot-only table (jobs, model_routes, job_artifacts, ledgers). Read by test/archive-readers.bh-6779.test.js R1.

readers.match:
s.created_at AS at
       FROM stage_events s

AS runners
         FROM cost_rows c
        WHERE c.ts >= ?1 AND c.stage IS NOT NULL AND c.stage <> ''${project ? " AND c.project = ?3" : ""}
        GROUP BY

stageIn(3, nStages)})
 GROUP BY c.project, c.ticket
 ORDER BY project, ticket
